description:
Dimensions of Lot: (Approximately) feet 78 wide by 100 feet long
Nearest Cross Street: Situate on the East side of Haug Street, 325 feet from the South side of Stone Road.
All liens and encumbrances known (actual and constructive) that exist against the property, With the approximate amount of such lien(s) and cumbrances.
If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 ansd 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the suplus, if any.
Sheriff sale subject to:
2024 open taxes in the approximate amount of $8,716.07
2025 open taxes in the approximate amount of $10,008.56
2026 open taxes in the approximate amount of $2,502.15
Totaling: $21,266.78 plus possible subsequent taxes, charges, interest and penalties.
